summary: MBody AI Ltd. (formerly Check-Cap Ltd.) filed a 6-K updating its Form 20-F business and risk-factor sections, disclosing the August 26, 2026 closing of its reverse-triangular merger with MBody AI Corp. under a September 12, 2025 Merger Agreement; Merger Sub merged into MBody AI Corp., which survived as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Former MBody AI Corp. holders received roughly 90% of shares, reduced to about 80.9% after a secondary offering of 1,538,462 shares at $6.50 for ~$10.0 million gross. Watch post-merger overhang and integration execution.
